image_description: A group of people dressed in colorful, traditional folk costumes (predominantly pink and blue dresses with headdresses) are dancing around a central wooden pole. The pole is decorated with long, multi-colored ribbons (streamers) extending from the top to the dancers' hands. The setting appears to be an outdoor field with hills in the background.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Faces lack distinct features, appearing smudged or painterly. Headdresses blend into hair/background with soft, undefined edges typical of AI generation.
The connection points between hands and ribbons are indistinct. Fingers are not clearly defined, and the ribbons appear to merge into the sleeves or hands rather than being distinctly held.
The hems of the dresses blend into the ground and each other, lacking clear contact shadows or distinct boundaries between individuals.
Some ribbons exhibit slight waviness or inconsistent tension that doesn't fully align with the physical pull of the dancers, though this is subtle.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'hands holding ribbons' area. AI often fails to render fingers gripping thin objects correctly, resulting in fusion. Also, check if the number of ribbons matches the number of visible dancers, as counting errors are common in such dense compositions.
